summary.en: Read text, convert numeric input and present clear results with print and f-strings.
summary.bn: টেক্সট ইনপুট নাও, দরকারে সংখ্যায় রূপান্তর করো এবং print আর f-string দিয়ে ফল দেখাও।

notes: These programs target Python 3.12 and use features available in Python 3.10 or later.

sections.title: Turn a fixed calculation into a conversation
Read a line and convert deliberately
Follow the data through a small bill
Read meaning and display it clearly

examples.title: A roll stays text
examples.explanationHtml: The input 0017 stays text, so its leading zeros survive. input removes the line ending, not the leading zeros.

examples.title: A small book bill
examples.explanationHtml: Each conversion changes numeric-looking text into an int. Multiplication then calculates 180 rather than repeating text.

examples.title: Control separators and line endings
examples.explanationHtml: sep places a hyphen between the two first arguments. end keeps the next print on the same line.

examples.title: Format a marks row
examples.explanationHtml: The numeric field has width 6, including its decimal point. Percent formatting multiplies the displayed fraction by 100.

practice.title: Add two daily costs
practice.statementHtml: Read two whole-taka costs on separate lines, each from 0 to 10000. Print their sum with no label.
hints: Convert each line before adding the values.

practice.title: Course code separator
practice.statementHtml: Read a department label and a numeric-looking course label on separate lines. Print them with one hyphen between them. Preserve all text.
hints: Use sep="-" instead of inserting extra spaces.

practice.title: Average two marks
practice.statementHtml: Read two real marks between 0 and 100 on separate lines. Print their average with exactly two decimal places.
hints: Divide the numeric sum by 2, then format the result.

practice.title: Aligned receipt
practice.statementHtml: Read a nonempty ASCII item label of at most 10 characters and then a whole-taka amount. Print the label left-aligned in width 10, a vertical bar, then the amount right-aligned in width 6.
hints: Use <10 for left alignment and >6 for right alignment.

quiz.prompt: What type does input() return after you type 42?
quiz.explanation: input reads text; the characters do not determine a numeric type automatically.

quiz.prompt: Which conversion accepts the text "12" as an integer?
quiz.explanation: int parses integer text; float creates a floating-point value.
The text is not an integer spelling. Do not hide this by assuming conversion always succeeds.

quiz.prompt: Which print parameter controls text between arguments?
quiz.explanation: sep joins the displayed arguments; end follows the entire call.

quiz.prompt: What does .2f request inside an f-string field?
options: Two digits after the decimal point
Two digits in the whole output
quiz.explanation: The f format produces fixed-point text with the requested decimal places.

quiz.prompt: When should a numeric-looking roll label remain a string?
options: When leading zeros are part of the label
Only when it has no digits
quiz.explanation: Identifiers can contain meaningful formatting that int conversion would remove.

quiz.prompt: Why avoid prompts in a program that must output only a sum?
options: Prompts add unwanted text to the required result
quiz.explanation: Interactive prompts help people, but a specified machine-readable result may exclude them.

quiz.prompt: Which punctuation comes from sep and end in these two calls?
quiz.explanation: The first call uses a hyphen separator and an exclamation mark instead of a newline.

quiz.prompt: What text is produced by formatting a stored amount to two decimals?
quiz.explanation: The literal prefix remains and .2f supplies the trailing zero.

quiz.prompt: How does adding converted numbers differ from adding text?
quiz.explanation: String addition joins text, while int conversion enables numeric addition.

keyPoints.en: input returns text after removing its trailing newline.
keyPoints.bn: input শেষের নতুন লাইন বাদ দিয়ে টেক্সট ফেরত দেয়।

keyPoints.en: Convert numeric text before doing numeric calculations.
keyPoints.bn: সংখ্যার হিসাবের আগে সংখ্যার লেখা উপযুক্ত টাইপে রূপান্তর করো।

keyPoints.en: Invalid numeric spellings can raise ValueError.
keyPoints.bn: সংখ্যার ভুল বানান রূপান্তর করতে গেলে ValueError হতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: sep joins print arguments and end follows the whole call.
keyPoints.bn: sep দিয়ে print-এর মানগুলোর মাঝের লেখা ঠিক হয়, end শেষে বসে।

keyPoints.en: F-string format fields control the presentation of results.
keyPoints.bn: f-string-এর ফরম্যাট দিয়ে ফল কীভাবে দেখাবে তা ঠিক করো।

examQuestions.question: Explain why adding two unconverted input values may concatenate them.
examQuestions.answerHtml: input returns str. For strings, + joins text, so 4 followed by 2 gives 42. Convert both inputs to int or float when numeric addition is intended.

examQuestions.question: Describe the difference between sep and end in print.
examQuestions.answerHtml: sep is inserted between displayed arguments. end is added after the final argument. Their defaults are one space and one newline respectively.

examQuestions.question: Design the input and output for a bill calculator using whole taka.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Read unit price and quantity as integers on separate lines. Multiply them and print the total with a clear label for a person, or only the number when the required output format says so.
